name: Cheraghi Academy V4 - Full Loop Exam Articles

parameters.jsCode: const subjects=[{name:'حقوق مدنی',from:1,to:20,status:'DONE'},{name:'آیین دادرسی مدنی',from:21,to:40,status:'IN_PROGRESS'},{name:'حقوق تجارت',from:41,to:60,status:'TODO'},{name:'اصول استنباط حقوق اسلامی',from:61,to:80,status:'TODO'},{name:'حقوق جزای عمومی و اختصاصی',from:81,to:100,status:'TODO'},{name:'آیین دادرسی کیفری',from:101,to:120,status:'TODO'}]; const corrections={47:{accepted_options:[1,3]},100:{accepted_options:[1,3]},106:{accepted_options:[1]}}; const out=[]; let articleIndex=0; for(const s of subjects){ if(s.status==='DONE')continue; for(let start=s.from;start<=s.to;start+=4){const end=Math.min(start+3,s.to);articleIndex++;const special=[];for(let q=start;q<=end;q++)if(corrections[q])special.push({question:q,...corrections[q]});const focusSeed=`تحلیل سوالات ${start} تا ${end} ${s.name} آزمون وکالت ۱۳۹۸`;out.push({json:{...$json,article_index:articleIndex,subject:s.name,q_from:start,q_to:end,question_range:`${start}-${end}`,batch_id:`1398-C-${start}-${end}`,focus_keyword_seed:focusSeed,special_corrections:special,status:'QUEUED'}});} } return out;

assignments.name: required_sections
assignments.value: question, options, answer, legal basis, analysis, wrong options, trap, example, Dr Cheraghi note, golden point

parameters.jsCode: const j=$json;const qs=Array.isArray(j.questions)?j.questions:[];const qPass=qs.length===4&&qs.every(q=>q&&q.analysis&&q.legal_basis&&q.wrong_options&&q.wrong_options.length===3&&q.trap&&q.example&&q.dr_cheraghi_note&&q.golden_point&&q.gates?.source_match===true&&q.gates?.key_match===true&&q.gates?.legal_support===true&&q.gates?.logic_consistency===true);const seoPass=!!(j.seo?.title&&j.seo?.meta_description&&j.seo?.slug&&j.seo?.intent&&j.seo?.primary_keyword);const wc=Number(j.word_count||0);const wordPass=wc>=Number(j.min_words||2500)||j.word_count_exception===true;const keywordPass=j.seo?.unique_focus_keyword!==false&&j.seo?.keyword_cannibalization!==true;if(!qPass||!seoPass||!wordPass||!keywordPass){let reason=!qPass?'Legal/article contract failed':!seoPass?'SEO contract failed':!wordPass?'Word-count policy failed':'Keyword uniqueness/cannibalization gate failed';return[{json:{...j,qc_passed:false,status:'NEEDS_REVIEW',publish_allowed:false,block_reason:reason}}];}return[{json:{...j,qc_passed:true,status:j.seo_data_status==='SEO_DATA_LIMITED'?'SEO_DATA_LIMITED':'READY_FOR_DRAFT',publish_allowed:j.seo_data_status!=='SEO_DATA_LIMITED',source_status:'verified',qc_status:'passed'}}];

parameters.jsCode: const all=$input.all();const counts={total:all.length,draft_ready:0,blocked:0,source_review:0,needs_review:0,seo_data_limited:0};for(const i of all){const s=i.json.final_status||i.json.status;if(s==='DRAFT_READY')counts.draft_ready++;else counts.blocked++;if(s==='NEEDS_SOURCE_REVIEW')counts.source_review++;if(s==='NEEDS_REVIEW')counts.needs_review++;if(s==='SEO_DATA_LIMITED')counts.seo_data_limited++;}return[{json:{workflow:'Cheraghi Academy V4 Full Loop',...counts,loop_complete:true,note:'Each pending four-question article is processed independently with source, legal, word-count, unique-keyword, SEO and draft gates.'}}];
